newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares up as economic recovery seen in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares up as economic recovery seen in 1997.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange continued the week's trend to close up Wednesday as investors were optimistic the economy would recover this year after a disappointing 1996, brokers said.
They added the market's general trend would be upward in the next few sessions, but that there could be a technical correction Thursday.
Wednesday, the General Index .IGRA rose 0.65 percent to 1,497.4 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index .ISEL climbed 0.89 percent to 2,128.3 points.
